messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
Try to convert it to a different format with cpptraj; it may be able
to give you a different error message that might provide a clue to
what could be going on.
cpptraj -p <topology file> -y <restart file> -x test.mol2
If that doesn't provide anything useful, send me the topology and
restart off-list and I'll look at it.
-Dan

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
Thanks for the files.
So I'm not sure from what restart file you originally posted, but the
restart file you provided indeed has no box lengths:
$ tail cpx_trpc6_lig1234_vmd.rst7
189.0290070 191.1210022  79.3610001 188.1759949 191.1479950  79.8539963
188.8079987 191.7709961  78.6460037 190.8939972 190.2449951  81.1250000
190.2180023 190.6580048  80.5289993 191.4479980 189.8049927  80.4459991
191.0240021 189.3040009  78.3399963 191.5279999 189.6609955  77.5770035
190.3419952 189.9940033  78.4469986 194.8569946 188.6029968  81.9499969
194.8750000 189.5509949  82.1880035 194.8220062 188.2039948  82.8570023
192.5800018 190.2070007  76.1800003 193.1390076 189.5899963  75.6569977
193.2859955 190.7169952  76.6439972 197.0240021 192.2440033  78.1320038
197.4010010 191.6999969  78.8679962 196.9949951 193.1179962  78.5989990
0.0000000   0.0000000   0.0000000  90.0000000  90.0000000  90.0000000
If you're certain you know what the box lengths are supposed to be, you can
set them with cpptraj:
parm   cpx_trpc6_lig1234.prmtop
trajin cpx_trpc6_lig1234_vmd.rst7
box x 190 y 190 z 190 alpha 90 beta 90 gamma 90
trajout box.cpx_trpc6_lig1234_vmd.rst7
However, it's probably worth trying to figure out how you lost your box
info in the first place. I used the 'check' action in cpptraj to check your
system using the box lengths you specified and I got over 5000 warnings
about close contacts - how did you generate the system in the first place?
-Dan
